svg.aria-label: Inventory display colour and grayscale state study
svg.text: ART STUDY 01 · Two 48 px slots · Selected name only · 320 × 104 px HUD
Native-size colour and grayscale. Static examples; no runtime assets or contract registered.
Both icons identify possession; underline identifies selection.
Only the selected name and ammunition change.
Slot 2 changes identity; slot 1 stays the rifle.
Weapon remains owned. R means ammunition is available in reserve.
R + RELOADING; blue progress occupies the ammunition track.
Keep the weapon visible; ! + NO AMMO distinguishes this from reload.
Inactive slot retains its icon and a compact warning badge.
Dash means no weapon. This is not a current gameplay state.
Reuse saved appearance geometry; no extra generation or icon vocabulary.
Single line: Quackback experimental…; full name remains accessible.
ICON CONSTRUCTION / 64 px artwork reduced to 34 px; fixed +x orientation
